subject: GCP Marketplace staging & procurement cutover for Aurelia Systems
messages:
From: Sam Rodriguez <sam.rodriguez@aurelia.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurelia Procurement <procure@aurelia.com>; Nina Park <nina.park@aurelia.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: GCP Marketplace listing: staging schedule and procurement questions

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the inference cost controls and routing fallbacks. We’re ready to move the listing into a staging environment on our GCP project but procurement has a few items they want confirmed before we start any billed testing. Quick questions from our side:  

- Do you have a standard PO / MSA we sign, or do you prefer DocuSign for the MSA + SOW?
- We need the SKU mapping and an estimate for a 30-day staging run to validate billing flows.
- SOC2 + data retention evidence: procurement asked for the latest report and a short summary of how logs/audit events are retained for Private deployments.

If you can send a checklist we’ll run it past finance today. Ideally we’d cut over to the staging GCP project the week of May 17th.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Rodriguez
Director, Cloud Platform
Aurelia Systems

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Rodriguez <sam.rodriguez@aurelia.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-07T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing: staging schedule and procurement questions

Hi Sam — great to hear, and congrats to your team on getting this far. Attaching a procurement checklist and the SKU mapping export for a reference staging configuration. Quick answers up front:  

- We use DocuSign for the MSA + SOW execution by default; we can accept your PO as a cover document for finance.
- Attached PDF has estimated token and instance cost for a 30-day staged run at the medium concurrency profile you demoed. We’ll help refine numbers after the first 48 hours of test traffic.
- SOC 2 summary: we typically provide the report under NDA; a redacted evidence pack for audit items (log retention, access control, KMS usage) is included as a separate secure Drive link in the checklist.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):  
1) Procurement paperwork (MSA + PO) — target signature by May 14.  
2) Staging project access & billing setup — Redwood to provide service account + SKU mapping by May 16.  
3) Canary run in staging (48–72 hrs) — week of May 17; we’ll monitor cost & latencies and adjust batching.  
4) Billing validation + go-live checklist — finalize by May 24.

Attachments: rwd_procurement_checklist_v2.xlsx, gcp_sku_mapping_Aurelia.pdf (attached).

I’ve looped in Marissa (on deployment ops) and Kimberly (sales ops/contracting). If Aurelia procurement prefers a different cadence, tell us and we’ll adapt.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Rodriguez <sam.rodriguez@aurelia.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-07T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing: staging schedule and procurement questions

Hi Sam — added a short ops checklist specific to the staging cutover below and included the SKU mapping PDF for the Aurelia reference (attached). A couple of operational notes:  

- Please create a GCP service account with 'Viewer' and 'Billing' permissions for the first pass; we will request temporary write perms for deployment if needed.
- Provide one project owner and one billing contact (name + email). We’ll need the billing contact for invoicing/PO reconciliation.
- For the canary run please reserve ~8 vCPUs and 32GB RAM instance profile for the main inference pool — that aligns with the medium-concurrency profile in our estimate.

Ops cutover checklist (short):  
- Service account + roles created by Aurelia
- Billing contact + PO template received
- DocuSign MSA routing confirmed
- Test dataset (anonymized) upload to staging GCS bucket
- Monitoring alerts set (latency, error rate, token burn)  

I’ve flagged the SOC2 evidence link on the checklist; legal can send a redacted pack under NDA. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the staging runbook.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Platform Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

(attachment: gcp_sku_mapping_Aurelia.pdf)

From: Aurelia Procurement <procure@aurelia.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Rodriguez <sam.rodriguez@aurelia.com>; Nina Park <nina.park@aurelia.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T13:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing: staging schedule and procurement questions

Hi Marissa / Markus — thanks for the checklist. Procurement has the following follow-ups before we route to finance:  

1) Please confirm Redwood’s standard payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45?) and whether invoices go to a centralized AP inbox.
2) Request a short statement (1–2 paragraphs) on data residency for staging projects (we’re in us-west).
3) We need a template PO filled out with a placeholder total for the 30-day staging run so our AP team can create the requisition. Attached is our PO template — if you fill the amounts we’ll use that to kick the internal flow.

Also, can you provide a single consolidated attachment with: procurement checklist, SKU mapping, and a redacted SOC2 evidence pointer? That will make our handoff faster.

Best,
Aurelia Procurement
(attachment: aurelia_po_template.docx)

Hi everyone — quick confirmation on next steps from Redwood Sales Ops so procurement can proceed:  

- Payment terms: Net 30 by default; we can agree Net 45 for enterprise deals with a signed SOW. Invoices should go to ap@redwood.ai.
- Data residency statement (staging): Redwood’s staging environment for Aurelia will be hosted in us-west1.
